issues.extracted: charges for services/fees (detail_category student activity receipts)
issues.issue: Every other activity account is Extracurricular Receipts, and the user rule puts school activity fund receipts in Extracurricular Receipts unless the report says otherwise. The label mentions interest, so part of this may be Interest Income, but the report gives no split. The same inconsistency applies to 'Senior High Fines' 40 (detail[255], p19), which is categorized charges for services/fees.

issues.on_page: Central Services - Business Services: District transportation (175,035)

issues.on_page: Other 22,578 (Other Governmental Funds column; Early Retirement Fund benefits, p23 'Support services - Business')

issues.on_page: Activities receipts 915,391 (p18-19 include Bank Interest 8,801 and 1st Central Bank CD 14,992)
